_note: The goblin's layers (docs/races/goblin.md), built on "Goblin Simple" by marianofer1996 (CC BY 4.0, CREDITS.md). Same shape as human.json. Only the body exists; the slots, the names and the colours are a proposal to try. Read by scripts/art/paperdoll.mjs --rules scripts/art/paperdoll/goblin.json.
_slots: Also the order used when two layers are equally far from the camera. "over" is new: the goblin's waistcoat goes over its shirt, so a top alone is not enough (not decided).
_body: The body is always there and is one layer: the skin with its eyes, fangs and claws, and the model's own shorts, rope belt (with its small sheath and pouch) and boots, which are the goblin's underwear (Michael, 2026-11-21). The model has no hips, thighs or feet under them, so they cannot come off. Every other piece of clothing is its own layer and lies ON the body: where it is nearer to the camera it shows, as the depth in each layer pixel decides. Nothing replaces the body, unlike the human's clothes.

goblin.model: Object_7 (G_MatUp: skin, eyes, fangs, claws) + Object_9 (G_MatDown: shorts, rope belt, sheath, pouch, boots)

_planned: Not made yet, each to be modelled to fit over the body: shirt with rolled sleeves (top), waistcoat (over), trousers (legs; wide enough to cover the shorts, ending at the boots), topknot (hair), later leather and fur armour pieces. Weapons and shields are the shared ones, rendered on the goblin's hands.
_materials: G_MatUp:eyes and G_MatUp:bone are not materials of the model: they come from the mask painted over its skin texture (character.py --mask), so the eyes, fangs and claws never take the skin's colour.
_ramps: The channels a layer pixel can name, in this order (ramps of scripts/art/style.mjs). Eight; the shader holds sixteen.
_colours: A goblin's skin is a colour swapped when it is drawn: every skin ramp has five tones, and a layer pixel holds the tone's place, not the colour (ramps whose tones are not equally light pick a neighbouring tone here and there: to be matched once the main skin is picked). skin_teal_deep (grey-teal with the darker shade end, Michael's cell 4) is kept as a variant; the greens are on trial (docs/races/goblin.md) until he picks the main one.
